prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create an original SOULMONSTERS environment concept panorama for CAIS VELHO, fifth championship neighborhood in contemporary Kronasta. WIDE 16:9 high three-quarter overview, professionally designed original 2D MANGA animation background, crisp economical ink, broad flat colors and one simple cel shadow per material, no painterly grain or photorealistic rendering. Rich distinctive architecture, clear calm walking surfaces and believable depth. The old fishing harbor has been adapted for current urban life, not a medieval port or rustic tropical hut village.
Composition: ONE sheltered deep teal inlet opening toward sea at upper left, with a curving grounded stone/concrete quay wrapping foreground and right. Three coherent connected districts: foreground arrival at port services; middle working fishing dock; rear lookout championship terrace. Sea horizon with restrained modern coastal city behind. Palette ivory, navy, seafoam green, terracotta/coral and selective safety amber. Underwater rock shapes visible only near shore, water below quay faces and below wooden/metal deck supports.
FOREGROUND port-service building is contemporary two-storey cream with deep blue folded metal roof and generous seafoam sunshade, glass entry, small maritime supply shop and ticket/help counter. Beside it a practical fish cafe, ice dispenser, bicycle rack, life ring cabinet and a few contemporary residences with balconies in separate lots on sloping back street. Access from real paved road with pedestrian crossing and one compact utility vehicle.
MIDDLE working dock: low ice/fish handling hall with sawtooth clerestory roof, open service bay showing washable counters, neatly grouped reusable fish crates, small electric pallet truck. TWO modest present-day fishing boats, white hulls navy/coral trim, outboard engines or compact cabin, safety rails and antennas. Distinctive functional SIGNAL KITES: small diamond-shaped colored fabric wind/signal kites tethered to short dedicated poles on boats, lines clearly visible and attached, not huge fantasy sails, not monster designs. Two short robust plank landing fingers on visible steel/concrete piles connect to land quay; bollards, rubber fenders and secured mooring lines outside walking route. One lower floating boarding pontoon linked by a continuous gently sloped hinged gangway, all ends clearly supported.
REAR RIGHT champion Marisol's lookout court on broad LAND terrace above fishing hall, reached by a readable wide stone staircase cut through retaining wall and a supported side sloped path. Court has two tamer positions, modest scoreboard and match camera, open sky for kite battle, blue metal shaded spectator bench. No rooftop court, no disconnected floating platform. Terrace rock/masonry side faces run down to continuous land base, no wall crossing stairs, no isolated stone columns near ramps. A small modern signal mast with weather vane helps skyline identity.
Few ordinary harbor workers and walkers for scale, no close-up faces, no creature art. Leave broad clear route from entrance to working dock to champion terrace. Do not overfill with crates, ropes, trees, nautical ornaments or repeated kite logos. No text, labels, captions, HUD, watermark, torches, straw roofs or medieval ships. Make support geometry and contact of every pier, staircase and bridge easy to read. Contemporary lived-in warmth, original memorable harbor silhouettes, clean manga production art.
